calculation.expression: mean_3((log(close/close[-20]) - mean_equity_log_return_20) * I(mean_equity_log_return_20 < 0 AND mean_equity_log_return_5 < 0 AND equity_negative_breadth_20 >= 0.5)).shift(1)
calculation.description: Cross-asset 20-day return relative to the eight-instrument equity basket, activated only when equity returns are negative, five-day equity returns confirm weakness, and at least half of equities have negative 20-day returns; three-observation smoothing and one-day lag prevent look-ahead.

validation.regime_notes: Full-history IC and ICIR pass benchmark gates; recent 120/252/756-day ICIR are 0.16588/0.29565/0.10926. Small cross-section uncertainty is mitigated by 4822 dates.
